The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm across the diagonal-ish span. In the image it spans roughly 385 px, which is about 0.067 cm per px... so about 67 px per 10 cm.

The apple is about 125 px wide, which is roughly 18 cm if the plate is 26 cm across. That is too large for an apple, so the plate is probably smaller, around 22-23 cm on its side. The apple is about 125 px and the plate about 370 px, so the apple is about 1/3 of the plate width. At 24 cm, that gives about 8 cm for the apple, which fits a medium-large apple.

A medium apple of 8 cm diameter weighs roughly 200 g.
